HIDE ANY APPS - END USER TERMS

Please read these terms before installing. By clicking "I accept the agreement"
and installing Hide Any Apps, you agree to the following.

1. WHAT THIS SOFTWARE DOES
   Hide Any Apps hides windows on your own Windows PC. It changes window
   visibility and extended window styles for processes you choose. It does not
   modify the files of the apps it hides.

2. LICENSE
   Hide Any Apps is free and open-source software under the MIT License. The
   full license text is installed as LICENSE.txt and is also available in the
   source repository. You may use, copy, modify, and redistribute it under the
   terms of that license.

3. NO WARRANTY
   THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
   IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
   FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
   AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
   LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING
   FROM, OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS
   IN THE SOFTWARE.

4. YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
   Use Hide Any Apps only on computers and accounts you own or are authorized
   to manage. Do not use it to hide monitoring, security, or other software in
   ways that violate the law, a workplace policy, or another person's rights.
   Some windows (for example, elevated administrator windows or protected
   system surfaces) cannot be hidden without additional privileges, and the
   software does not attempt to bypass those protections.

5. PRIVACY
   Hide Any Apps does not collect telemetry, analytics, or personal data. It
   stores your settings and hidden-window recovery data locally in
   %APPDATA%\HideAnyWindow. Nothing is sent to the developer. The installer and
   app do not require an internet connection.

6. THIRD-PARTY COMPONENTS
   The package includes AutoHotkey (GPLv2), the .NET runtime, and Microsoft
   Windows App SDK components. Their licenses are included with the installed
   files or in the source repository. The MIT license above applies to the
   Hide Any Apps source code, not to those components.

7. UNINSTALL
   You can uninstall from Settings > Apps > Installed apps, or from the Start
   menu uninstall shortcut. Uninstalling removes the app and its autostart
   entry. Your local settings in %APPDATA%\HideAnyWindow are left in place so a
   reinstall keeps your rules; delete that folder manually to remove them.
